meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 它会先为改动范围内的文件补上回归测试锁住现有行为,再按九类 AI 代码痕迹逐项清理,最后跑测试、lint、类型检查等质量门禁并做一次复核;验证不通过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动里的 AI 代码痕迹时触发。默认范围是当前分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可由调用方指定文件列表。

say.text: 帮我清理这个分支改动里的 AI 代码痕迹
say.note: 会先补回归测试锁住行为,再逐类清理

say.text: 只清理 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 这两个文件
say.note: 以指定文件列表作为范围

say.text: 这个文件超过 250 行了,拆成职责清晰的模块
say.note: 会先给出拆分方案再动手

howto.what_en: It first adds regression tests pinning current behavior in scope, then runs a categorized multi-pass cleanup of nine AI-slop categories, then verifies with quality gates and a critical review. Failing verification triggers revert or direct edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main; a caller may pass an explicit file list instead.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in this branch's changes
say_en.note: Adds regression tests first, then cleans by category
Uses that file list as the scope

say_en.text: This file is over 250 LOC, split it into focused modules
say_en.note: Presents a split plan before executing
